incidents.name: HODL reflection deliver() + pair skim
incidents.notes: HODL's RFI-style deliver() burned the caller's reflected balance and inflated tokenFromReflection() for everyone else, so the attacker repeatedly delivered and skimmed the HODL/WETH pair to convert the inflation into WETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: HODL 0xEdA47E13fD1192E32226753dC2261C4A14908fb7 created 2021-11-23T23:40:20Z by 0xc9d76a540ac88182119e1aad80136fc61cf55fbd (the fee-excluded address the PoC skims to), unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (531.3 days). ~2.3 ETH x $1,843.55 at incidentTimestamp 1683611039 (DefiLlama) = $4,240.
